text:
Nora (partnerships): morning team — quick runbook check for the marketplace co-launch. need to confirm: 1) partner logo + integration diagram, 2) signed quote for PR, 3) SI sandbox creds for the technical preview. deadlines: assets by Mon 17:00 PT, quotes by Mon 20:00 PT.
Liam (marketing): i'll own the PR draft + hero. posting two CTA options by 11am PT (partner-forward + neutral fallback). will also prep a short embargo note to send partners.
Cecilia (product): staging at staging.redwood.com/marketplace-coannounce. noted missing: partner-auth.svg and example deployment snippet. if not in by 15:00 PT, i'll swap to neutral diagram and a generic k8s example.
Ravi (solutions): SI preview depends on creds. if partner provides token+endpoint today, we can run live preview tomorrow 09:30 PT. otherwise we'll record a guided demo. also need a sample dataset (anonymized).
Priya (legal): legal requires signed quote/email approval before we include partner name in PR. embargo clause must include UTC timestamp. suggest embargo Tue 16:00 UTC. avoid performance superlatives unless partner backs them.
Nora (partnerships): embargo set Tue 16:00 UTC. partners must return assets + signed quote by Mon 20:00 UTC. fallback behavior: neutral CTAs + company-only quote.
Liam (marketing): noted. drafting fallback hero: "Run inference where your data lives — with Redwood." i'll upload both variants to CMS.
Cecilia (product): small CSS tweak: when logo missing, hero height collapses on mobile. will add placeholder with aspect-ratio CSS and deploy by EOD. low-risk patch.
Ravi (solutions): pinged partner at 2109876600 for creds. they said endpoint will be provided "after security checklist" today. @Nora can you escalate for an ETA?
shiproom-bot: created ticket RED-PART-6022: "Marketplace co-launch assets + SI preview" assigned to Liam/Cecilia/Ravi, due 2025-02-03 20:00 UTC. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-PART-6022
Nora (partnerships): escalating now. copying checklist into thread:
```
- Embargo: Tue 16:00 UTC
- Assets (logo SVG, integration diagram): Partner -> due Mon 17:00 PT
- Signed quote for PR: Partner -> due Mon 20:00 PT (Priya to review)
- SI sandbox creds + sample data: Partner -> Ravi -> aim today
- Hero copy + fallback: Liam -> 11:00 PT
- Staging placeholder for missing logo: Cecilia -> deploy by EOD
```
Liam (marketing): posting draft PR blurb: "Today we’re announcing a partnership to make high-throughput LLM inference available through the Redwood Marketplace." tagging @Priya for legal check.
Priya (legal): suggest reword: remove "high-throughput" unless partner signs off on benchmark claims. replace with "production-ready" or omit. once partner sends signed email we can include them by name.
Cecilia (product): placeholder CSS deployed at 2109876720. staging now shows neutral diagram when asset missing.
Ravi (solutions): partner uploaded partial creds at 2109876745 (token only). working with them for endpoint and sample data. if not received by 18:00 UTC we switch to recorded demo.
Nora (partnerships): last call before shiproom: if anything fails to land by deadlines we default to fallback messaging and schedule partner spotlight for a later date. reconvene at dry run 1hr before embargo.
Liam (marketing): will post final hero + a short social schedule in this thread when ready.
Priya (legal): ill review any partner quote immediately once posted here. please @Priya in-thread.
Ravi (solutions): will confirm sandbox status by 2109876800.
Nora (partnerships): thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for launch gating. add blockers here and i'll escalate.
